description: This Java class 'SecretFromPathReader' reads secret data from a file specified by a Path, creates a Secret object with the file's name and content if available, and provides an Optional<Secret> result. It includes static factory methods for instantiation and handles IOExceptions and empty files gracefully.

classes.name: SecretFromPathReader
classes.description: A final, immutable class that implements Supplier<Optional<Secret>> to read secrets from files based on a Path or name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Secret read from the file, or empty if reading fails or the file is empty.

methods.name: tryToReadSecretFromPath
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse the secret from the file path, handling exceptions, returning null if unsuccessful.

methods.name: readSecretFromPath
methods.description: Reads lines from the file and constructs a Secret if the file is not empty; throws exception otherwise.
